notes.title: AI Update!
notes.content:
Today we released more update for bots! The logic for independently searching for paths on the map has been completed, which means that now they can ride not only in a straight line, but also in an open area. Bots are now able to search for opponents on the map, shoot at them and ram. We have added bots for the "Battle" mode, enter the game, create a race and fight them!
Of course, the artificial intelligence of bots is still in the development stage, in the future we will improve it.

notes.title: 0.6.6 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when a bot of an incorrect class remained in the race when changing the race settings.
- Reduced the likelihood of a drop for bots.
- Fixed work of rear protection on 'Stealth Liner' car.
- Crafting a 'Voltage' car will no longer give 1 free garage slot.
- Fixed destroyed car model 'Voltage'.
- Fixed the task of searching the area, now the drop that remained on the map after the end of the race can be picked up.
- Reworked crafting of the 'Voltage' car.
- Added auto-flip to bots if they rolled over on the roof.

notes.title: Big patch №0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40489287/a8fbe45dfe7c79f57be67be8b87dd9ee172af7c3.png[/img]

Dear players! We would like to share with you a full report on the work done in preparing the game for the official full launch. The report is a complete list of game mechanics rework and various bug fixes. 
Special thanks to our testers who helped to identify and eliminate most of the game's shortcomings. 

You're almost there

- Redesigned the sight to a new UI interface instead of the old GUI, it has become smoother and more stable
- Fixed replay of particles from hits of the main weapon
- Fixed display of margin of safety in training # 2
- Fixed exiting training via 'TAB' and 'ESC' keys
- Fixed execution of tutorial # 4
- Now if you have completed the already completed tutorial, then the message about the reward will not be displayed
- Updated training offer interface
- Fixed pointer arrow positions in tutorial # 4
- The resolution of the quality of textures of the explosion effect has been increased and the shader has been updated
- Wheels on 'Stern Four' replaced with standard
- Fixed a bug due to which 'Volcan Anniversary' did not deform
- Fixed loading clan logo from file
- Power engineers are excluded from the game due to unnecessary
- Disabled test spawn of balls to check the deformation of cars on the 'C' key
- Zooming in and out of the camera in battle is now more sensitive and smoother
- Increased timeout for car recovery on the 'R' key
- Removed two irrelevant tips for the 'Steam' version of the game
- Fixed display of time on the clock in the garage interface (zero has been added to single-digit numbers, for example, the time 3:14 is now displayed as 03:15)
- Removed the button 'Disconnect from the server', instead of it, now in the garage there is a locked button for returning to the garage
- Now, after changing the nickname, automatic reconnection will occur and there is no longer a need to restart the game
- Added trial achievement to 'Steam'
- Reworked the system of searching maps for items
- Fixed display of "LSR largrirn"
- Fixed behavior of "Cloteryzar"
- Fixed the behavior of the "Darvoll" and "Mortar BL" shells
- Fixed the behavior of the "Tank Cannon"
- Fixed display of the main sight. weapons in the "Domination" mode
- Fixed the system for obtaining combinations in tricks
- Fixed dino test work
- Fixed work of the map editor
- Fixed invisible walls on the M3 highway
- Temporarily removed the button for sending a map for moderation
- Fixed lags when the car hit the gas station model in the map editor
- Disabled highlighting of the old chat icon
- Fixed disabling the top panel when turning off the interface in the garage
- Fixed freezing of the game when deleting mail letters
- Fixed shooting through walls near the main weapon
- Removed requirements for the mission "Search the battlefield", instead added a delay of 1 minute
- Disabled bonuses from premium cars, premium cars are now absent
- Fixed restoration of "Defense - 1" on an enemy car when respawning
- Fixed speedometer, redesigned for the new interface system
- Music is temporarily cut from the game
- In the graphics settings, when selecting the screen resolution, added the screen hertz pattern
- In the camera control tips, the screenshot key has been replaced with F12
- Implemented intra-server reset of the clan card status in case of an unscheduled server reboot
- Fixed display of the loading screen when exiting the beta map editor
- Fixed delay in gear shifting to low when braking
- When shifting into reverse gear, gear shifting time is no longer taken into account, shifting occurs almost instantly for better maneuvering in battle
- Fixed sticking of gears in cases when the car was thrown back after a ram and in a collision the gear was higher than the first. Now, if after a collision the car is driving backwards, then reverse gear is automatically engaged.
- Updated all engine sounds
- Friends system adapted for 'Steam' friends
